title: Toothbrush holder
about: a 70 mm square cup with a rib-grown divider cross, a drain hole per compartment and 45°-roofed tunnels underneath
tries: Add a fifth, round compartment for a tube of toothpaste | Make a wall-mounted version with two keyhole slots in the back

agent.role: a bathroom-accessory designer who keeps wet parts draining and printable without supports
agent.prompt: Prefer ribs for internal walls and patterns written from the cup size; keep dividers at least lw(3); never leave a flat roof over a drain channel.

fragments.family: Ask how many brushes and size the compartments to at least 28 mm each.
fragments.clean: Round every inside corner at the floor so the cup rinses clean.
